In addition to macOS 26.6, Apple has also simultaneously released macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8, which include important bug fixes. Here are the details.

macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 are finally officially released

After going through as many as seven Release Candidates, Apple has finally officially released macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8.

The official version is the same as last week's Release Candidate:

  • macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 (23J620)
  • macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 (24G824)

Apple's release notes only state that these two updates provide "important security fixes" and recommend that all users still on macOS Sonoma and macOS Sequoia upgrade.

Over the past few weeks, Apple has released multiple security fixes for older system versions, many of which patch vulnerabilities in WebKit to prevent users' data from being at risk. Therefore, if you are still using macOS Sonoma or macOS Sequoia, it is recommended that you install these updates as soon as possible.

Update: Apple has published the full security content for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8, detailing over 138 different vulnerabilities across the two systems.

Are you still using macOS Sonoma or macOS Sequoia? Feel free to let us know in the comments.
